title: SKF_STACK_RESULT_JSON envelope (v1)
description: Single-line JSON document skf-create-stack-skill prints, prefixed with the literal 'SKF_STACK_RESULT_JSON: ': on stdout when step 9 (report) finishes, before it chains to the health check, and on stderr at every HARD HALT (status error). The shared emitter, skf-emit-result-envelope.py, builds every line from the payload a step stages in the run folder, folds in the auto-decisions and warnings the run recorded there, derives exit_code from halt_reason, stamps run_id and result_path, and checks the line against this schema, so the model never types it. The skill's references/invocation-contract.md lists each halt with its step; each halting step file shows the emit-halt command.

skf-envelope.description: The shared emitter's settings for this workflow, read by skf-emit-result-envelope.py: the workflow, the line's prefix, the wrapper, the status a halt carries, the exit code of each halt_reason and the result file stem. Nothing in the schema references this entry, so it constrains no envelope.

status.description: 'success' when step 9 finished the run, 'error' at every HARD HALT.

skill_package.description: Absolute path of the committed stack package, {skills_output_folder}/{stack_name}/{version}/{stack_name}/. Null at every HARD HALT: no halt comes after step 7 committed the package.

skill_name.description: The stack's published name, {stack_name}, as step 1 bound it. Null for a halt before step 1 bound it (config-missing, or a stack_name step 1 refused).

stack_libraries.description: The libraries of the stack: dependency names in code mode, constituent skill names in compose mode. At a halt, the confirmed libraries when step 3 confirmed them, else [].

mode.description: The run's resolved mode; null for a halt before step 1 chose it.

quality_score.description: The skill-check score step 8 recorded for the committed package; null when skill-check did not run and at every halt. It is not a test-skill score: [TS] grades the stack.

exit_code.description: Derived from halt_reason: null gives 0; config-missing, input-invalid, no-manifests, all-extractions-failed, schema-version-mismatch and unknown-verdict-token 2; forge-tier-missing, helper-missing and resolution-failure 3; write-failure 4; not-skf-output and flat-layout 5; user-cancelled 6.

halt_reason.description: Null on success. The failure class of a HARD HALT, so a pipeline branches on it without parsing the message. helper-missing: a shared helper the run needs resolved to no path (re-install SKF).

phase.description: Where the run halted: the step file and the check, for example 'detect-manifests:enumerate'.

reason.description: The halt message the step displayed, on one line.

path.description: Optional: the file or folder the halt names, such as a missing helper's probe path or the folder the ownership check refused.

error.description: Present at a HARD HALT only: where the run stopped and why.

run_id.description: The run folder's id, stamped by the emitter from {run_dir}'s name; null for a halt before the run folder exists.

result_path.description: The per-run create-stack-skill-result-<YYYYMMDD-HHmmss>.json the emitter wrote in {forge_version} on success, beside its -latest copy; null at a halt and when the write failed (warnings say why).

gate.description: The gate a headless run resolved by its default: step 1's compose suggestion and scan-scope question, step 3's scope gate and step 6's review gate. Each records its decision in the run sink the moment it decides.

taken_action.description: The action the run took; in a headless run it equals default_action.

reason.description: Why, such as 'headless: kept the recommended scope'.

evidence.description: Optional gate data. The scope gate gives scope (the libraries kept) and dropped (each library the default left out, with its reason), so no library leaves the stack unrecorded.

headless_decisions.description: One entry per gate the run resolved without asking, read from the run sink, so a halt reports the decisions taken before it. [] when there were none.

warnings.description: The run's workflow_warnings[], one '[<step>/<severity>] <code>: <message>' string each as the steps recorded them in the run sink, then any the emitter raised (result_file_write_failed, a sink line it could not read). [] when none.
